pages.text: The dimensional mineshaft houses a $(#AA00AA)Djinni$() which opens up a stable connection into an$(br)  uninhabited dimension, perfectly suited for mining. While the portal is too small$(br)   to transfer humans, other spirits can use it to enter the mining $()

pages.title: Operation
pages.text: The dimensional mineshaft will discard any items it cannot store, so it is important$(br)to regularly empty the mineshaft, either manually, with hoppers or using a transporter spirit.$(br)Interactions per side:$(br)+ Top -> lamp $()

pages.title: Operation
pages.text: slot;$(br)+ Bottom -> ores slots;$(br)+ Other -> all slots;$(br)

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: The dimensional mineshaft has two interactions with redstone:$(br) 1. The spirit will stop working when receives a redstone signal;$(br) 2. A comparator can be used to extract a signal based on occupied slots and lamp durability.$()

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: $(br)  Tip, if the comparator sends a power of 10, it is better to stop the operations.$(br)

pages.title: Enchantments
pages.text: You've noticed that your miner can be enchanted? Here's how effective it is!$(br) $(bold)Efficiency:$() Increase the progress bar by the smaller of two RNB;$(br) $(bold)Fortune:$() Mine a number of extra results equals smaller of three RNB;$(br) $(bold)Silk touch:$() $()

pages.title: Enchantments
pages.text: Multiply the count of mined result by 1 plus a RNB;$(br) RNB = random number between 0 and the enchantment level.$(br)

pages.title: Durability
pages.text: The $(bold)Unbreaking$() and $(bold)Mending$() enchantments function as vanilla.$(br2) With other methods (mods) you can make your miner unusable ($(bold)unusing$())$(br) when it's close to breaking, or even truly unbreakable ($(bold)eternal$()).$(br)

pages.title: Config
pages.text: If you want to save your miners before they break, check "Server Configuration > Items".$(br) By setting the "Save miners before breaking" option to "on", a miner will go to the output$(br) of the dimensional mineshaft when it reaches 1 $()

pages.title: Config
pages.text: durability. The effects of enchantments can also be turned off.$(br)
